description: Spot market metadata from Hyperliquid's public info API ({"type":"spotMeta"}) — every spot trading pair Hyperliquid lists, each with its pair name (e.g. "PURR/USDC"), pair index, the two token ids it is composed of, and whether it is the canonical listing for that token. Hyperliquid names most non-canonical spot pairs generically ("@1", "@2", ...) because the human-readable name belongs to the canonical pair; this tool returns Hyperliquid's raw naming as-is. Use the `index` from here as the `coin` argument to hyperliquid_l2_book/hyperliquid_candles for a spot pair, in the form "@<index>" (Hyperliquid's own convention for spot coin ids distinct from perp symbols).
name: hyperliquid_spot_meta
title: Hyperliquid Spot Meta
